html:
My first astronomical image was of the Great Nebula. This region of the sky holds an incredible fascination for all amateur astronomers because it is so full of objects.

Here is a new image in Hydrogen Alpha (Ha)


The technical details
Date:  2011/02/12 
Optical train = Nikkor 80-200 ED f2.8 lens @ 200mm f4.0 - Astronomik Ha 12nm filter - Canon xsi unfiltered
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II driven with the TheSky6 software
Site: At home
10 exposures of 10 min for 100 minutes
Flat and bias applied
PixInsight
Unguided mount

The result of the "Plate Solving". There are a lot of objects...
